class: measured gate stream for one iteration and for its adjoint; the loops are projections
why_the_adjoint_costs_the_same: every gate in the loop is an ixor_gf2_mul, which is its own inverse and never touches its own operands, so the adjoint is the same multiset in reverse order; the two counts are compared, not assumed

measure_based_uncompute.phase_caveat: none: mr measures in Z and leaves the tracked phase alone

accounting.conclusion: the complete packed decoder totals 1,916,145.0 Toffolis, 4.83x the archive's 396,919 -- the archive is 20.7% of the measured construction. The uncompute pass is not cheaper than the forward one (313,110 against 313,110), and the Forney sweep is the dominant term at 67.3%

mr_availability: the shipped extension exposes reset, hmr and del_and -- and no mr, and no Hadamard -- so the clear is measured with reset; `kickmix_mr_opcode.patch` adds a phase-preserving mr to the source. reset, hmr and mr all emit zero ANDs, so the count below is the count for all three, and only phase safety differs
